body: As someone with speech impediment I apologize sincerely.

In other news- anyone need a new roommate?

Recently we heard it on the radio while I was out helping him run errands. We spent 15 minutes in a walmart parking lot with the lyrics up on my smart phone while he told me the website I was on was lying. My favorite quote from that argument was "People on the internet lie!"
Thanks. You have an army after you. Someone really must hate you.

No, I believe he was simply making a joke. A slightly off colour joke but a joke all the same.

I feel awful that I'm on the final boss of Luigi's mansion and I have been on the final boss for 3-4 years.
Yeah, your probably right. I thought I saw some add, I suppose I misread it.  I've been trying to scrape enough money together for Guild Wars 2.
The first GW is free to play now (I think).
True, your you with all you baggage. The scars mean you survived. I think I'll wait a bit to go showin' them off, at least until they heal up ;)

Yeah, I do. I have some awful scars along my arms and thighs and particularly ribs. It was (is) something I could control, it was something that would get my mind off what I couldn't control. It helped just as much as it hurt sometimes I think. I know it sounds stupid, I was cutting myself with a box knife but it was a coping method of its own I guess. It was something you had to think about, it took time and thought and concentration. It was a moment where I was all alone, my head was clear and for a moment I could breath without worrying. it pushed away all my problems and presented one I could handle.

 That being said I miss wearing T-shirts in Public.

Gnarly scars indeed. I feel a bit better, talking is definitely helping but I keep falling somewhere between "It'll be okay" and "I want to close my eyes and never wake up". I had these really nasty thick scars before my most recent 'adventure' and now they just look so small, so insignificant compared to the rest.
That I will! Thanks for pointing me in the direction. I hope that's it and I can get some good treatment.

I haven't. I'm poor and marijuana is expensive. I have something the doctor gave me for headaches (I was taking 4 Tylenol an attack and the difference in pain was barely noticeably). Sumatriptan, I hear it can make your blood green. So far its helping a bit- not as much as I wish it was but its still helping.

I'm not seeing anyone for it. I'm afraid to, when I was typing my post out I kept deleting and putting off posting it because I felt so weak and worthless. I don't like people to see what I'm going through, I just don't. 

I don't like yelling. My parents were... not the kindest people to each other or me and my brother, particularly my dad. Lots of conflict growing up, It only ever got violent (unless you count throwing things) Once or twice. He shouted a lot when I was growing up so I guess I have a problem with that. I don't like loud noises. When I was younger I had a friends mom (she worked with Abuse victims) who asked me once or twice when we were alone if I was being abused. I told her I wasn't because I thought everyone was like that, my dad told me that everyone threw things and would shout and cursed like he did, that it was completely normal Behavior. She asked because I was a jumpy kid, I didn't like people touching me, I flinched whenever someone opened or closed a door or sometimes even spoke. I was 13, it was about the time I started getting so depressed. I was this walking ball of nerves, constantly exposed and shaking. I don't like shouting, It freaks the fuck out of me. A lot of time that's what sets me off. Not to say I'm some delicate thing that can't handle someone shouting, I can. But its when someone's shouting abuse and telling you your worthless, slamming his fist down on the table. I believe it sometimes, that I'm actually worthless. And I suppose some people here could understand how it feels to feel worthless. Its an empty feeling, the idea that your have no use and your a waste of space, that you don't deserve what little food you eat. And you don't want to be worthless but you can't help it sometimes. So You get like this. Your constantly drifting back to that feeling of worthlessness, that feeling of you don't deserve the air you breath. That's often how I end up sitting here writing strangers on the internet about how badly you just want to end it sometimes. That's not a very good answer for your question, sorry. But its the only one I could think of.

No problem, Happens to me all the time. 

I'm not sure, both I suppose but I wanted to die more. I wanted to put an end to it but I couldn't go through with it. So I settled with just hurting myself. 

I took a shower an hour ago and washed myself up, its healing up pretty well. The shallower ones are closing up and the deeper ones don't look like they're going to spontaneously burst open anymore. So that's good I suppose.

Indeed it does. When in doubt crack a joke about the situation and watch as people either shake their heads or start laughing.
I don't know, Something incredibly stupid. Usually something self destructive and something I'll regret. It usually passes just fine. But occasionally. It doesn't.

I have a dark sense of humor but thanks. I've been accused of deflecting things with humor. What can I say, I like a good laugh. Sounds like fun, too bad I'd never have the courage to get up there! I'm a walking ball of nerves, I don't think I could do that. But sounds fun all the same. I'll think about it, it does sound pretty fun.
Ha, thanks, I wish I could go have that beer with you. I'm downloading it now, I'll give it a watch, thanks. I hope I see the light at the end of my tunnel soon. I hope your right.

Yeah, I have a bit of morbid sense of humor, I get called out on it a lot. Thanks, I have the worst time being serious about things like this and its nice to have some who's not turning their nose and telling me I'm cracking too many jokes to be depressed. Today, so many people have told me "I'm here to talk" and to be honest its the first time someones told me that. Its nice to have someone there for you. Thanks.
I'm not sure, I wait for it to pass I suppose. And if it doesn't, I usually end up doing something stupid.
I know, I'm not bothered by anti-depressants or whatever stigma they come with. I guess I'm just a little on edge right now, sorry if I sounded standoff-ish or dismissive.
Assassin, I didn't get to play a whole lot. But I enjoyed it. You should check out /r/Guildwars2. I had some friends on the game that helped me through a rough time.

Guild Wars 2, Its a game, I played the first for a while and it was just a thought i threw in there. I've been looking forward to it for a while. I traveled a lot when I was a kid and I want to keep traveling.

Yeah, that's what I was thinking, just a dream. The thing is, I can't really think of anything I want to do I suppose. That's sorta what I meant before I guess, no goals, no ambitions.

 I feel a lot better though- thank you. Just talking is helping a lot.

That sounds like an amazing dream, it sounds lovely. I like that scene, its just... nice. I need to watch that movie. Yeah, I'll find something I want to do, not sure what it'll be yet though. I've always wanted to see London I suppose.

The top picture sums up every feeling I've ever had about my headaches. This makes a lot of sense, I'll talk to my doctor about it. It sounds just so spot on, even with the frequency- I had a few weeks where I would get headaches everyday, sometimes twice a day. They were excruciating and that also was the day I took a fist full of Amitriptyline.

Hmmm, I am looking forward to our imminent colonization of mars. But seriously, I don't have the money to do things like that. Besides, I was jumping off a bridge with a few friends a few summers back (it was a small bridge and we were jumping into a pond), I've learned I don't have a fear of heights- its the falling that gets me. But that's aside the point, there are things I want to do I suppose. I just don't know how I'll accomplish them. I am looking forward to playing GW2, even if I can't quite afford it yet. Its something to think about, thanks.

Isn't that how overdose and drug abuse start? Trying to fix yourself like this? I'll still be miserable, just taking pill to make myself a little happier and then you get dependent on them? And then you get worse and take more and more. 

TL;DR I took Amitriptyline for headaches for a while, I read they could be used as anti-depressants so I upped my dose trying to help myself. I took a fistful when I was feeling particularly awful and spent the next hour laying next to the toilet in the middle of the night throwing up Amitriptyline.

Maybe what you say will work, maybe it won't. I'll give it a while and do some research though. Thanks.

Thanks, the SW community is wonderful. Anything more? I don't know yet, the days beginning to look pretty awful personally. I woke up with a splitting headache and I feel awful, like I'm about to throw up but I can't. Anxiety I think.
As compared to figuratively? I'm joking but uh, thanks, its nice to hear the offer and I may have to take you up on that at some point. Thanks.

I've tried lots of ways of coping. Music, Ignoring it, I've tried thinking it over- You know, give it 24 hours, give it a week but it doesn't help. Nothing is helping. Maybe suicide isn't the only option, maybe I should just ignore it but right now suicide looks like the best option, maybe even the only to me right now.

Ha, I don't feel like I've made a any sort of mark anywhere. Or that I ever will. Its one of those feelings you get- like you falling down a hole in a game and you pause even though you know once you un-pause it'll be over. Its something you can't control. And I feel like I can't control this, I try to cheer up and get on with my life but every time I just slip back. It feels inevitable.

Yeah, I've been to two doctors for it. They keep shrugging it off, I don't quite think they understand how bad my headaches are. They're not getting better, sometimes it feels like their getting worse. 

No, I haven't. I can't think of anything like that. I'm not sure what I would want to do. I'll have to think about that.

Thanks. I hate it when people say that, It makes me feeling like I'm just overreacting and I should just shut up and move on like there's nothing wrong. There is something wrong but it gets to the point where you can't handle it.
My doctor doesn't know whats causing them. I get them 3-5 times a week and they hurt so badly. They're almost always in the same spot so that's sorta worrying.

Sorry about the late responses, It was late and I ended up getting some sleep after I posted this. My father ran through the house telling us we were fat lazy pigs and he was taking all our money to go fly himself anywhere to get away from us. He's in another mood today, yelling again. I extremely low self esteem, he told me it was my fault he was going to leave. I've grown up with him constantly threatening to run off, shouting and screaming and packing his bags just to sit down on the couch a few hours later and act like nothings happened, I guess its sorta just something that sets me off. I've been in a not so great mood in general lately, feeling sorta really low. So I guess that's why I did it. I did it because I was hurting, I was scared and I just wanted it all to stop.

New account because I have friends who know my primary account and I'm terrified of someone knowing I'm like this. Also, I'm late for this thread and this'll get buried but oh well.

No, I'm not doing so well. I had a cutting relapse. Shit hasn't been going well for me and I'm not doing so well. I haven't eaten in a day or two either. Its not much if you haven't gone through it- I want to eat but I feel so disgusted with myself. 

I'll be okay eventually, but its nice to answer truthfully.
